titolo: Hawaii Is Hiding Something More Dangerous Than You Think

scene.testo: Hawaii looks like paradise, but it sits on fire.
Every island here was built by volcanoes.
Hot rock rises from deep below.
The largest active volcano on Earth is here.
Mauna Loa erupted in 2022, after thirty-eight quiet years.
Measured from the seafloor, Mauna Kea is taller than Everest.
Most of that giant mountain is hidden underwater.
But the fire is only half of the story.
Kilauea erupted almost nonstop from 1983 until 2018.
In 2018, its lava swallowed hundreds of homes.
Lava meeting the sea creates clouds of steam.
And then there are the waves racing across the Pacific.
In 1946, a tsunami slammed into the city of Hilo.
And deep below, a new island is being born.
Its summit lies nearly a kilometer beneath the surface.
Scientists call it Kamaʻehuakanaloa, once known as Lōʻihi.
But that's not the strangest part.
